auth.lead: Short, positive daily guidance and a shared log for the whole family.
auth.tagline: Train your puppy, a little every day

cold.message: Raised kennel, dry straw and shelter from the wind.
cold.title: Cold

firstWeekVet.message: Checkup, health record and microchip. Ask about the vaccination schedule, year-round deworming and leishmaniasis prevention, which is common in the area. Talk to your vet.
firstWeekVet.title: First week: vet

grassAwns.message: Check ears, paws and nose after every walk.
grassAwns.title: Grass awns

livestockAndHens.message: Don't let her off leash nearby until she has mastered "come" and "leave it".
livestockAndHens.title: Livestock and hens

pineProcessionary.message: Keep her away from pine trees and lines of caterpillars. If she touches or bites them: veterinary emergency.
pineProcessionary.title: Pine processionary caterpillars

poisonsAndChemicals.message: Keep poisons, fertilizers, diesel and workshop products out of reach.
poisonsAndChemicals.title: Poisons and chemicals

ticksAndHeat.message: Always shade and fresh water. Parasite protection: talk to your vet.
ticksAndHeat.title: Ticks and heat

unknownDogsUntilVaccinated.message: No contact with unknown dogs until she has completed the vaccination schedule your vet recommends.
unknownDogsUntilVaccinated.title: Unknown dogs

week1.readyWhen: Turns her head when she hears her name

week2.how: Reward over the head; same potty spot every time
week2.readyWhen: Sits for the hand signal, with no treat in the hand

week3.how: Crouch down, happy voice, play between two people

week4.how: Leash indoors; "ouch" and stop the game
week4.readyWhen: Walks a few yards on leash

week5.how: Treat from nose to floor; closed fist
week5.readyWhen: Moves away from a closed hand

bowls.label: Heavy food and water bowls that do not tip over

breederFood.label: The same puppy food the breeder uses, for the first days

cleaning.hint: Enzymatic cleaner breaks down the smell of pee and poop, so she doesn't go back to the same spot. Don't use bleach or ammonia: they smell like urine. The bags are for picking up poop.
cleaning.label: Enzymatic cleaner and bags for accidents

collarAndLeash.label: A soft collar with an ID tag and a light leash

familyRules.label: Family rules: the same word for each cue, who feeds her and where she sleeps

kennel.label: A kennel raised off the ground, sheltered from wind and rain, with dry bedding

litterBlanket.label: A blanket with the smell of her litter (ask the breeder)

safeArea.label: A safe area: close off the workshop, tools, chemicals and cables

toys.label: Chew toys and a tug toy, as an alternative to biting

vetVisit.label: A vet appointment for the first week

principles.calmPlay: Play is fine, but chasing over and over (balls, sticks) shouldn't be the center of her day; balance it with exploring and calm.
principles.endWell: Always end on a good note.
principles.foodAndSleep: She eats 3 times a day until 4–6 months and sleeps 16–18 hours.
principles.lowerDifficulty: If something isn't working, make it easier.
principles.noFenceWatching: Watching the fence or the road isn't her job: don't let her spend hours on guard.
principles.restAfterActivity: After activity comes rest: go out, train, eat, sleep.
principles.sameWords: Everyone uses the same words: {{name}}, come, sit, down, stay, joga, leave it, off, good.
principles.shortSessions: Sessions of 3 to 5 minutes, several times a day.
principles.smallRewards: Pea-sized treats taken from her daily food. A special treat (boiled chicken) only for "come".
principles.sniffing: Let her use her nose: hide a few treats in the grass and let her find them.

afternoonRest.instructions: Long nap. Potty break when she wakes up.
afternoonRest.title: Rest

bedtime.instructions: Into the kennel with her blanket and a chew toy. Same routine every night and a calm goodbye.
bedtime.title: Bedtime in the kennel

breakfast.instructions: "Sit" before the bowl goes down. If she doesn't sit, wait without repeating the cue.
breakfast.title: Breakfast

calmTime.instructions: Gentle play, a short brushing and a potty break before sleep.
calmTime.title: Quiet play, brushing and potty

farmWalk.instructions: Potty break and a calm walk in a safe part of the farm, away from the workshop and the animals.
farmWalk.title: Potty and farm exploring

greeting.instructions: Calm greeting and straight to the potty spot. "Good" and a treat when she's done.
greeting.title: Greeting and potty

leashWalk.instructions: Short walk on a loose leash. Reward her when she walks by your side. If she pulls, stop.
leashWalk.title: Leash walk

lunch.instructions: Midday meal. Set aside some kibble for the session treats.
lunch.title: Lunch

morningRest.instructions: A quiet spot with her chew toy. Let her sleep.
morningRest.title: Rest with a chew toy

session1.instructions: Say her name and reward her when she looks at you. Then "sit" with the treat over her head. End with something she already knows.
session1.title: Session 1: name and "sit"

session2.instructions: Crouch down 3–6 ft away, happy voice, "come" and a special treat when she arrives. End with something she already knows.
session2.title: Session 2: "come" from a short distance

session3.instructions: Review what she knows and try this week's new cue. End with something she already knows.
session3.title: Session 3: review and new cue

socialization.instructions: One new experience, at a distance where she stays calm. Reward calm and curiosity.
socialization.title: Today's socialization

tugPlay.instructions: Tug play. If her teeth touch skin: "ouch", pause the game for a few seconds, then start again.
tugPlay.title: Tug play (soft bite)

visit.instructions: Potty break and gentle handling of paws and ears, with a treat for each touch.
visit.title: Check-in: potty and handling

come.description: Comes to you when called. Special treat: boiled chicken.
come.name: Come

down.description: Lies down following the treat from nose to floor.
down.name: Down

leash.description: Walks next to you on a loose leash.
leash.name: Leash

leaveIt.description: Moves away from a closed hand or something on the ground.
leaveIt.name: Leave it

name.description: Turns her head and looks at you when she hears her name.
name.name: Name

potty.description: Goes potty in the usual spot.
potty.name: Potty

sit.description: Sits on the verbal cue or the hand signal.
sit.name: Sit

softBite.description: Controls the strength of her bite during play.
softBite.name: Soft bite

stay.description: Holds a sit for a few seconds until released with “joga”.
stay.name: Stay

animalAdultDogs.howTo: Only known, vaccinated, calm dogs, once your vet says it's OK.
animalAdultDogs.label: Vaccinated, well-balanced adult dogs

animalCats.howTo: On leash; the cat must be free to leave. Reward calm.
animalCats.label: Cats

animalPoultryLivestock.howTo: Always on leash and at a distance; reward her for looking and then looking back at you.
animalPoultryLivestock.label: Hens or livestock (on leash)

handlingBrushing.howTo: Two or three strokes and a treat.
handlingBrushing.label: Brushing

handlingCollar.howTo: Put it on during meals or play; take it off when she's calm.
handlingCollar.label: Collar

handlingEars.howTo: Lift an ear for a second and reward.
handlingEars.label: Ears

handlingHarness.howTo: Let her put her own head through to get a treat; buckle it and reward.
handlingHarness.label: Harness

handlingMouth.howTo: Lift her lip for a second and reward.
handlingMouth.label: Mouth

handlingNails.howTo: Show her the nail clipper and touch her nails with it, without cutting; treat.
handlingNails.label: Nails

handlingPaws.howTo: Touch a paw for a second and reward; build up slowly.
handlingPaws.label: Paws

handlingTail.howTo: Touch her tail gently and reward.
handlingTail.label: Tail

noiseAngleGrinder.howTo: From outside the workshop and far away; short bursts with treats.
noiseAngleGrinder.label: Angle grinder

noiseBrushcutter.howTo: Far away and briefly; reward calm.
noiseBrushcutter.label: Brush cutter

noiseCar.howTo: Engine running at a distance; move closer bit by bit if she stays calm.
noiseCar.label: Car

noiseChainsaw.howTo: Far away and briefly; reward calm.
noiseChainsaw.label: Chainsaw

noiseHammer.howTo: Single blows at a distance; a treat after each one.
noiseHammer.label: Hammer

noiseThunderFireworks.howTo: A recording at very low volume during meals; turn it up a little on different days.
noiseThunderFireworks.label: Thunder or fireworks (recording)

noiseTractor.howTo: Start far away, with treats while it runs. Never bring her closer if she gets scared.
noiseTractor.label: Tractor

noiseWelder.howTo: Noise at a distance, without looking at the arc; short bursts with treats.
noiseWelder.label: Welder

peopleCap.howTo: Put the cap on in front of her and reward while she watches.
peopleCap.label: People wearing caps

peopleChildren.howTo: Children sitting calmly, with an adult nearby; one treat each.
peopleChildren.label: Children

peopleGlasses.howTo: Sunglasses and safety glasses; reward calm.
peopleGlasses.label: People wearing glasses

peopleHelmet.howTo: First leave the helmet on the ground so she can sniff it; then put it on.
peopleHelmet.label: People wearing helmets

peopleMen.howTo: Have him crouch down and offer a treat with an open hand.
peopleMen.label: Men

peopleVisitors.howTo: Have the visitor ignore her on arrival and reward her when she comes over on her own.
peopleVisitors.label: Visitors

peopleWomen.howTo: Have her crouch down and offer a treat with an open hand.
peopleWomen.label: Women

peopleWorkwear.howTo: Coveralls, boots and gloves; let her sniff them first.
peopleWorkwear.label: Work clothes

placeCar.howTo: First inside the parked car, with treats; then very short rides.
placeCar.label: Car

placeGrass.howTo: Short grass; play and a treat.
placeGrass.label: Grass

placeGravel.howTo: Let her explore at her own pace and reward every step.
placeGravel.label: Gravel

placeMetal.howTo: A metal sheet on the ground, held firmly so it doesn't rattle; reward every step.
placeMetal.label: Metal

placeMud.howTo: A small mud puddle; reward her when she steps in it.
placeMud.label: Mud

placeShallowWater.howTo: Water below her paws, on a mild day; never force her.
placeShallowWater.label: Shallow water

placeStairs.howTo: Just one or two steps, going up; help her down.
placeStairs.label: Stairs

placeVetSocialVisit.howTo: Go in, get treats and leave, with no exam.
placeVetSocialVisit.label: Social visit to the vet
